description:
Act on any improvement at any time: Auto improvements only says whether Sightkick makes them by itself. An id is a suggested change's or another page's.
action:
- approve(id): Queue a change on the next free day. The old version is kept.
- skip(id): Not this one: off the list, the page rests (60 days, 90 for another page).
- unqueue(id): Back into the list, off its day.
- restore(id): A skipped change back into the list.
- undo(id): Take a live change out and send the page out again.
- redo(id): Put an undone change back, with a new 28-day reading.
- decline_issue(check): Decline a site finding for 60 days.
- restore_issue(check): Bring a declined finding back.
- complete_todo(actionId, result?): Mark a to-do done, with what was done.
- skip_todo(actionId): Skip a to-do: not raised again for 60 days.
- scan: Check the site now (at most every ten minutes).
- indexnow(urls, key?): Tell IndexNow (Bing, Copilot) pages of the site are new or changed: up to 100 per call and per day. A site you ship yourself passes the key it serves at /<key>.txt.

id.description: An id from get_improvements suggested or other_pages

name: update_improvements
title: Act on improvements
